title: Steelers say DK Metcalf will play, Pat Freiermuth is questionable with calf injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers say DK Metcalf will play, Pat Freiermuth is questionable with calf injury
sources.description: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf is no longer on the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, but tight end Pat Freiermuth now is.
